scope: Mineral & Walnut only: great room, kitchen, sunroom and second-floor stair hall. Sixteen current images; no regeneration or shared-manifest edits.
status: source_audit_complete; K2 single-opening source repair required
method: Visually inspected all 16 current files, actual labeled model-home photos and fresh blueprint PDF page 3. Used 1600px JPEG previews and original-resolution detail crops for privacy-shade checks. Current source photographs and plan were read afresh; old render-audit assertions were not adopted automatically. Structural opening failures are distinguished from camera coverage limitations, adjoining-room design inconsistencies and night shade artifacts.
constraints: Do not change selected C1 kitchen porcelain, island waterfall or current Mineral & Walnut finish specification during architecture/shade corrections.
Photos govern observed opening elevation and primary camera; page 3 governs unseen adjacencies. A small camera shift is not proof of a moved opening.
Sunroom observed banks are two on short side and three on long side, with separate high transoms. Do not import first-floor two-unit requirements wholesale.
No runners; retain original curved/fanned quarter-turn staircase and straight upper flight.
A render matching an earlier incorrect render is not an architecture pass; independent source/plan review confirms K2 added pier and second arch are wrong.

The plan places fireplace on printed-plan right/east side and terrace access at printed-plan top. Current GR1/GR2 retain those observed openings and the compact room/crown profile.

Independent source and page-3 review confirms K2 camera-left arch subdivision is wrong: the actual reverse camera has one broad arch, not two door-framed openings.

issues.correction: Restore the actual second-floor-main-kitchen.jpg.webp reverse-camera crop and ONE broad screen-left arch, including powder door and stair guard visible through the opening. Remove added wall pier and second arch. Retain refrigerator short return, island sink/DW, cooktop aisle, right arched corridor, C1 porcelain, island waterfall and agreed fixtures.
